method: CadQuery BREP validity, exact Boolean intersections, nominal distances and camera pupil prisms, STEP round-trip, glTF bounds, anchored sources, planform keepouts, and local stack sums.

missing_evidence: display driver location and flex geometry
board layer count and rigid-flex split
actual SoC or NPU package dimensions
memory interface width and routing topology
final cell chemistry and safety stack
usable energy after protection and cycle-life limits
vapor chamber supplier limits at target thickness
actual graphite grade and anisotropic conductivity
latent heat capacity in thin form
USB speed and charging power target
discrete chip versus SoC-integrated root of trust

caveat: Camera pupil prisms screen nominal solid geometry, not optical transmission. Contacts and small gaps are not tolerance clearances. No fit, performance, or release approval is implied.

memory_study.caveat: Planar package boxes do not include solder lands, via escape, decoupling, shields, thermal contacts, or X2 memory-channel rules.
